overview: مجموعه‌ای از ماجراهای ناموفق رخ می‌دهد وقتی بستر به‌عنوان یک مجرم در حال فرار شناخته می‌شود.
overview_en: Dumb luck sets some policemen on his trail -- after a series of innovative escapes, he gets mistaken for a murderer with a price on his head, which means the people that aren't chasing him are fleeing from him.
